notes: The supplied object it after burn is added under rule 44: הַמִּזְבֵּחַ is the accusative the ASV reaches with upon, and no object morpheme stands in the clause.
The ב of בְּקֻמְצוֹ goes unrepresented because the ASV writes his handful with no preposition.

Rule 33 was weighed for the supplied upon and rejected: rule 44's own examples (טָחוּ תָּפֵל → daubed with untempered mortar) put a preposition written for a bare Hebrew accusative in the verb's unit, and the head is unaffected either way.
